scope: 1970-1999 narrative games; no VNDB, NextMoe, or PC-98 catalogue harvesting
selectionMethod: Previously staged Wikidata historical discovery and targeted CASA/MobyGames public game pages; each MobyGames page is independently checked for year and adventure gameplay. Only minimal bibliographic facts are retained.
